name: Cleopatra VII
role: The last active ruler of the Ptolemaic Kingdom, whose political ingenuity shaped the fate of Egypt and Rome.
quote: "She is more than a queen. She is Egypt itself."

moments.title: Ascension to the Throne
moments.desc: At 18, Cleopatra becomes pharaoh. The priests bow. The Nile flows full.

moments.title: The Meeting with Caesar
moments.desc: Rolled inside a carpet, revealed to the most powerful man on Earth.

moments.title: The Last Morning
moments.desc: Alexandria has fallen. The asp waits, coiled among figs. Her final choice.

name: Achilles
role: A mythical Greek hero of the Trojan War, known for his unmatched prowess in combat and a fateful vulnerability.
quote: "I carry two sorts of destiny toward the day of my death."

moments.title: Wrath Begins
moments.desc: Agamemnon takes Briseis. Achilles withdraws from battle, and Troy breathes again.

moments.title: Patroclus Falls
moments.desc: Hector slays Patroclus wearing Achilles's armor. The sea echoes his grief.

moments.title: The Arrow's Arc
moments.desc: Paris, guided by Apollo, looses the arrow that finds Achilles's heel.

name: Marie Antoinette
role: The last Queen of France before the French Revolution, symbolizing the lavish excesses of the Bourbon monarchy.

moments.title: Arrival at Versailles
moments.desc: A young archduchess enters the most magnificent court in Europe.

moments.title: The Women's March
moments.desc: The crowd surrounds Versailles. The queen steps onto the balcony alone.

moments.title: The Conciergerie
moments.desc: A cold cell. Her hair is cut. The tumbrel waits outside.

name: Julius Caesar
role: A brilliant Roman general and statesman whose rise to absolute power led to the demise of the Republic.
quote: "Veni, vidi, vici — I came, I saw, I conquered."

moments.title: Crossing the Rubicon
moments.desc: Caesar pauses at the river's edge, then steps forward. The die is cast.

moments.title: The Ides of March
moments.desc: Twenty-three senators surround him. Et tu, Brute?

name: Nikola Tesla
role: A visionary electrical engineer who conducted groundbreaking experiments in alternating current and wireless energy.
quote: "The present is theirs; the future, for which I really worked, is mine."

moments.title: Chicago World's Fair
moments.desc: Tesla illuminates the White City with AC. A million bulbs glow. Edison watches.

moments.title: Colorado Springs
moments.desc: In his laboratory, Tesla conjures artificial lightning 130 feet long.

name: Leonardo da Vinci
role: The quintessential polymath of the High Renaissance, pioneering techniques in painting, anatomy, and conceptual engineering.

moments.title: The Mona Lisa
moments.desc: He mixes layers of glaze, blending light and shadow into an enigmatic smile.

moments.title: The Flying Machine
moments.desc: Sketching wings modeled on bats in his Florentine workshop.

name: Joan of Arc
role: A young peasant girl who, guided by divine visions, miraculously led French forces during the Hundred Years' War.
quote: "I am not afraid; I was born to do this."

moments.title: Siege of Orléans
moments.desc: Bearing her white standard, she leads the charge. The English army breaks.

moments.title: The Pyre at Rouen
moments.desc: Bound to the stake in the old marketplace. She asks for a cross to hold.

name: Alexander the Great
role: The ambitious King of Macedon whose continuous military campaign forged one of history's largest empires.
quote: "There is nothing impossible to him who will try."

moments.title: Battle of Issus
moments.desc: Charging directly at Darius III, breaking the Persian line and changing the world.

moments.title: The Final Fever
moments.desc: In Babylon, his generals ask to whom he leaves his empire. 'To the strongest,' he whispers.
